text:
If you're under 25 and still on dating apps, read this twice.

Dating apps cap how many women see you. Instagram does not.

On apps she swipes your photo and moves on. On Instagram she watches your life for 30 days before you ever speak.

Some men never need to chase. Now you know why.

The move:
1. Build an Instagram that shows who you actually are.
2. Post for 90 days without quitting.
3. Let women come to you already knowing you.

You are the algorithm now. Start building.
caption:
Men who build with discipline get more dating attention than men who chase. That is a mindset shift most skip.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#discipline #selfimprovement #mindset #datingpsychology #men
